jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Cosuno Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in. Your mission As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar. What you will achieve in your first year You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract. You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies. Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview. You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers. You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win. You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire. What the job really looks like The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations. You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them. You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves. There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire. You push back when a profile, a process or a decision is not right. We want you to. What you bring At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth tech company, hiring software engineers. A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling. Technical fluency: you understand modern tech stacks and roles (full-stack, backend, AI/ML, platform) well enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers. Proven technical sourcing skills across LinkedIn, GitHub and tech communities, including Boolean and X-ray searches. Structured assessment: you have built interview loops with engineering teams and keep them fair, fast and consistent. Strong closing skills: you win engineers against competing offers, including from big tech and AI companies. Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to have German language skills. Experience hiring AI/ML engineers. Experience with cross-border hiring in Europe, including Employer of Record set-ups. Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha. Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries. What we offer Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period. jobs.title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: What is Anori Tech doing? The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work. As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development. We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry. We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years. Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market. Our Motivation At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg. About the Role A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers. Start date : from January 1, 2027 What You'll Do Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud What You Bring Must have Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed) Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms Strongly preferred Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data Nice to have Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper) You don't tick every box? This is a hybrid role.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.</h2> <p>We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.</p> <p>We are now looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer (Golang)</strong> to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.</p> <p>This role will be based in <strong>London</strong>, <strong>UK</strong> as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.</p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.</li> <li>Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.</li> <li>Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.</li> <li>Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.</li> <li>Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.</li> <li>Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.</li> </ul> <h2>Our expectations:</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.</li> <li>1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.</li> <li>A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput dis

jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Server-Driven UI (Codeless)
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.</p> <p>While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>This is a role with broad impact, from hands-on technical guidance to championing web and mobile accessibility across the company. We're looking for a leader who excels at fostering collaboration and can confidently guide a concept from initial idea to robust implementation.</p> <h3><strong>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Strategy: </strong>Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). jobs.description: About the role Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast. We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team. Your core responsibilities will be to: Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers Requirements You’re a great match if you: Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production. Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day. We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here . Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI! About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager - Paris
jobs.description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. About the Marketing Team Marketing at Pelico is a growth function, not a support function. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world. Our audience is senior: COOs, VPs of Operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders at enterprise accounts. Events are one of our strongest levers for reaching them: trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and Pelico-hosted events in Europe and the US—occasionally co-hosted with partners and industry bodies, which means co-building the format, splitting the cost, and sharing the audience. We measure ourselves on meetings and pipeline, not on badge scans. Your Mission You'll own Pelico's event growth engine end-to-end, turning field events into a measurable, efficient source of qualified pipeline and customer engagement. Decide what we do and what we stop: You own the portfolio—which events we commit to, which we drop, and which formats get more budget next year. This is the heart of the role. Own the event portfolio from strategy and prioritization through delivery, follow-up, and post-event review: That covers trade shows, webinars, executive dinners, roundtables, as well as Pelico-hosted, customer, and partner events. Tie every event to a commercial outcome: For each event, you'll define the target accounts and audiences, the meeting and pipeline goals, and the metrics that matter. Run delivery and budget with discipline: You'll set clear timelines, owners, and vendor plans, keeping spend under control across many activities at once. Get Sales and BDRs committed: No event goes ahead without Sales ownership, a prospecting plan, pre-booked meetings, and a named follow-up owner. Make results visible: You'll set up reliable lead capture and HubSpot tracking so leads, meetings, opportunities, and costs can be tracked for every event. Turn events into content: Speaker and customer interviews, event films, social coverage, and approvals with appearing customers—coordinated with team members who produce it. Expect travel: Up to 3 trips per quarter, including on-site setup days. Your Impact Field events become a measurable contributor to pipeline, meetings, and MQLs. Budget moves toward the formats that work—scaling efficient levers like webinars and challenging underperforming formats before investing in them again. A repeatable event playbook (targeting, execution, lead capture, follow-up, and post-event review) is published and used across Marketing, Sales, and BDRs. Pelico is seen as the premier enterprise B2B player in its category: executives want to attend Pelico events and return for the next one. What We're Looking For This

jobs.description: Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions. Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos. Présentation de la thématique : Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments. Description de la mission La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable. Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée. Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: About Uncovr Uncovr is building AI-powered infrastructure for the future of surgery. We work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, surgical video, clinical workflows, and healthcare technology. Our mission is to help surgical teams better understand, document, and improve surgical procedures by turning complex clinical data into structured, useful, and trustworthy insights. We are a fast-moving startup working on technically ambitious problems with real-world clinical impact. As we expand our platform, we are looking for an AI Engineer to help build, test, and improve the AI systems that power our product. About the Role We are looking for an Senior AI Engineer to help develop reliable, accurate, and production-ready AI capabilities for complex clinical workflows. In this role, you will work on AI system development, model integration, evaluation, testing, and production readiness. You will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to turn product requirements into AI capabilities that are useful, reliable, and scalable. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to build practical AI systems in production, not just experiment with models in isolation. What You’ll Do Build, test, and improve AI systems that support Uncovr’s product. Work on AI workflows, model integration, evaluation, and production readiness. Integrate language models, multimodal models, and AI services into product and backend systems. Help improve AI system reliability, accuracy, latency, and robustness. Build and maintain evaluation workflows for AI outputs across product use cases. Test AI capabilities against real-world clinical and product scenarios. Help identify uncertainty, edge cases, failure modes, and inconsistent outputs. Support the development of validation layers that make AI outputs more reliable and useful. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate requirements into working AI capabilities. Contribute to logging, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and test coverage. Analyze feedback, corrections, and evaluation results to improve system behavior over time. Document AI workflows, assumptions, limitations, and known failure modes clearly. What We’re Looking For Experience in AI engineering, applied ML, backend engineering, software engineering, or a related technical role. Strong Python skills and good software engineering fundamentals. Experience working with language models, multimodal models, AI APIs, or model-driven systems. Practical understanding of how to build, test, and debug AI-enabled product workflows. Ability to reason about AI system behavior, including errors, uncertainty, hallucinations, and failure modes. Experience integrating AI capabilities into backend services or product workflows. Familiarity with evaluation, testing, benchmarking, or quality checks for AI outputs. Ability to work closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex workflows. Clear communication skills and a willingness to document technical decisions, assumptions, and limitations. Comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment. Nice to Have Experience with multimodal AI systems, vision-language models, or AI systems using complex data. Experience with video understanding, computer vision, medical imaging, or healthcare AI. Familiarity with retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation pipelines, or AI observability. Experience building evaluation datasets, scoring workflows, or benchmark suites. Experience with human-in-the-loop systems or expert feedback workflows. Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, or AI infrastructure. Experience working in regulated, high-trust, or safety-critical environments. Interest in surgery, clinical workflows, medical technology, and healthcare AI. Who You Are You are technical, curious, and motivated by building AI systems that work reliably in real-world settings.

jobs.description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables. GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz. Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires. jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. jobs.title: Stage HSE / Veiligheid
jobs.description: Hoe kun jij bijdragen? Wil jij tijdens je stage direct bijdragen aan een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving binnen een technische productieorganisatie? Bij NX Filtration krijg je de kans om onze huidige Risico-Inventarisatie & Evaluatie (RI&E) kritisch onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken in hoeverre deze nog aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk. Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak. Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie. Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw stage is: “In hoeverre sluit de huidige RI&E van NX Filtration aan op de actuele risico's binnen de organisatie en welke verbetermaatregelen hebben de hoogste prioriteit?” Wie zijn wij NX Filtration produceert membraanfilters die wereldwijd worden gebruikt om de kleinste vervuilingen uit water te filteren. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Dit heeft geresulteerd in nieuwe en eenvoudige processen voor de behandeling van water, het hergebruik van afvalwater en de productie van drinkwater. Het motto van NX Filtration is “schoon en betaalbaar water voor iedereen”. In 2024 is een geheel nieuwe, zeer moderne fabriek in Hengelo in gebruik genomen. Wat vragen we van jou? Je volgt een relevante HBO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld: Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, of een vergelijkbare technische of veiligheidskundige opleiding. Je hebt interesse in HSE, arbeidsveiligheid, productieprocessen en continu verbeteren. Je werkt analytisch, zorgvuldig en gestructureerd. Je durft medewerkers en leidinggevenden op verschillende niveaus te interviewen. Je kunt waarnemingen objectief vastleggen en vertalen naar concrete en uitvoerbare verbetervoorstellen. Je bent praktisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om zowel zelfstandig als met verschillende afdelingen samen te werken. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en bij voorkeur ook de Engelse taal. Wat bieden we jou? Een impactvolle stage op het gebied van HSE en arbeidsveiligheid, met een stagevergoeding á €500,00 (o.b.v. 40 uur). En omdat gezond werken ook belangrijk is, staat elke maandag en woensdag vers fruit voor je klaar. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Implementatiemanager Sociaal Domein    |   Gemeente Den Haag
jobs.description: De opdracht   Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht . Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking. Je: ·       brengt regie, structuur, tempo en doe-kracht in de verander- en implementatietrajecten; ·       ontwikkelt en begeleidt implementatieaanpakken die bijdragen aan duurzame verandering; ·       hebt sterke veranderkundige vaardigheden en het vermogen om gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap bespreekbaar te maken;  ·       hebt bewezen implementatiekracht : je weet veranderingen te vertalen naar concrete acties, resultaten en borging;  ·       hebt ervaring met transitievraagstukken en het begeleiden van organisaties in verandering; ·       adviseert over risico's, aanpak en passende veranderinterventies; ·       stimuleert bewustwording, dialoog, eigenaarschap en samenwerking; ·       maakt verschillende perspectieven en patronen zichtbaar en bespreekbaar; ·       ontwikkelt praktische tools en werkvormen die de verandering ondersteunen; ·       bewaakt voortgang en resultaten en stuurt bij waar nodig. Je weet daarbij effectief te schakelen tussen denken en doen, richting geven en ruimte bieden, tempo maken en reflecteren . Naast de twee veranderopgaven ben je in de lead voor de pilot rondom implementatie- en transitiemanagement, waar deze opdracht de input voor levert voor de afdeling Opgaven & Ontwikkeling . Jouw formele opdrachtgever is één van de managers van het team Organisatieontwikkeling voor dit deel van  jouw opdracht. Wie zoeken wij? Je bent een stevige, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe veranderopgaven kan doorgronden én realiseren. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen management en medewerkers, creëert draagvlak en bent organisatiesensitief. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van organisatieontwikkeling, verandermanagement en implementatiemanagement. We zoeken iemand die veranderkundige scherpte combineert met implementatiekracht en management en teams help

Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments. Our Mission Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads. Your Role As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will: Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms). Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads. Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort. Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance. Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself. Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads. Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments. Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support. Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification. Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases. Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics. You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following: 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams. Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it. Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates. You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need. You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy. Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week. You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters. Experience with Jira. jobs.title: UX Product Designer
jobs.description: We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day. Our Mission Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended. This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it. Your Role As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will: Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App. Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution. Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed? Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk. Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned. Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track. Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production. Help mature our design system in Figma. You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following: 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints. Experience with B2B SaaS products. You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving? You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production. Strong Figma skills. Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language. A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked. Strong candidates may also Have worked on AI products. Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech. Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing. Have experience running usability studies or user interviews. Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up. What we offer Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance. Ideally 40 hours per week. Travel and lunch allowance. Home office budget. Lease bike. Training budget of €1,500 per year. Company MacBook. ClassPass membership. Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi. Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them. Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies. Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeter

Jij zorgt ervoor dat al onze collega’s hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en draagt bij aan een gezonde werkomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en het management om de kwaliteit, arbeidsomstandigheden en het milieu te optimaliseren. Welke uitdagingen horen onder andere bij deze functie? Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van werkplekinspecties en veiligheidsrondes . Je bent regelmatig te vinden op onze verschillende bouwlocaties; Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden en bespreekt dit met de KVGM-coördinator; Deelnemen aan en ondersteunen bij verschillende interne en externe audits ; Registeren en onderzoeken van incidenten, ongevallen en bijna-ongevallen; Onderhouden en verbeteren van het KVGM-managementsysteem; Het opstellen van een veiligheidsplan ; Het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving zowel op kantoor als op onze diverse bouwplaatsen; Zorgdragen voor draagvlak binnen KOERS van veiligheidsbewustzijn; Het uitvoeren en up to date houden van de RI&E; Het verzorgen van veiligheidsinstructies, toolboxen en voorlichting ; Het regelen van keuringen van gereedschap en materieel. Je standplaats is Barendrecht (Rotterdam) , maar bent ook regelmatig op onze diverse projectlocaties (omgeving Randstand) te vinden. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en draagt bij aan periodieke rapportage aan onze Directeur Bouw. Wat verwachten wij van jou als KVGM Medewerker? Betrokkenheid, zelfstandigheid, een scherp oog voor veiligheid & kwaliteit en daarnaast plezier in je vak! Maak je werk uitdagender door op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe ideeën en werk daarin samen met je collega’s binnen KOERS. Is dit wat je zoekt? Dan hopen wij dat je over de volgende eigenschappen beschikt: Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau , een opleiding in het vakgebied MVK genoten en ervaring binnen de bouwsector ; Kennis van de relevante wet- en regelgeving; Kennis en ervaring omtrent ISO 9001, ISO 14001, VCA en SCL is een pré; Je hebt oog voor risico’s en uitdagingen; Je bent energiek , sociaal, ondernemend en daadkrachtig; Je bent flexibel en bezit het vermogen om snel te kunnen schakelen ; Je staat sterk in je (werk)schoenen en hebt oog voor detail. Wat bieden we jou? Een verantwoordelijke functie waar je als KAM Medewerker bijdraagt aan het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving. Daarnaast bieden we jou: Een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week; Een goed salaris dat boven de normen van de cao Bouw en Infra ligt. We gaan hier graag over in gesprek met jouw achtergrond en ervaring als uitgangspunt; Een auto van de zaak met tankpas volgens onze leaseregeling; Een informele werksfeer en gezellige collega’s ; Goed geregelde vrije dagen , 30 vakantiedagen, 10 dagen in het tijdspaarfonds en nog 3 dagen kort verzuim. In totaal dus 43 vakantiedagen. Deze zaken zijn uiteraard conform de cao Bouw en Infra; Een goed ingerichte werkplek; Pensioenopbouw conform de richtlijnen van de CAO Bouw en Infra, dit bouwen wij samen op; Een periodieke bijdrage aan je duurzame inzetbaarheid , zodat je gezond kunt blijven werken; De mogelijkheid voor het volgen van opleidingen en/of cursussen, want jouw groei/ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Wij kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons opleidingsbudget. Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van KOERS? Wacht dan niet langer en reageer gelijk op deze vacature! jobs.title: Team Lead - Platform Engineering
jobs.description: About the role: We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform. Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python. Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services. You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services. If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it! Your responsibilities: Your Team Lead tasks will include: Organizing the work and managing priorities Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them Setting up project teams and mentor project leads Hiring new team members Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team  Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment Your Development tasks will include: Designing, developing and testing new features in our services Improving the reliability and robustness of our application Working on scalability and performance improvements Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers Breaking down big projects into smaller issues Writing clear and actionable issues Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues Who are you? You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically. To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience: You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader. You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective. You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them. You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus. You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git. You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs You have strong communication and problem-solving skills You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude. You value high software engineering standards. You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc). You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this). jobs.title: Marketing Afstudeerstage
jobs.description: Ben jij onze toekomstige Marketeer? Wij vertellen enterprise-klanten al jaren hetzelfde: dat content zonder structuur niet schaalt. Onze eigen marketing heeft dat fundament nog niet. Bouw jij dat met ons mee? Over Twentyseven Wij bouwen content platforms voor enterprise-organisaties die wereldwijd opereren. Steeds vaker bouwen we ook de laag erboven: orchestration, content intelligence en governance. Denk aan Haskoning met zo'n 6.000 engineers wereldwijd, TIAS Business School en Itho Daalderop. Het zijn organisaties waar content dagelijks door tientallen markten en tijdzones reist.  We zitten in Eindhoven en zijn onderdeel van Handpicked: 11 bureaus en zo'n 300 collega's. We zijn drie keer uitgeroepen tot Best Agency in Digital Development (Emerce100), waarvan twee jaar op rij! Het team bestaat uit engineers, architects en strategen. We zijn direct, kritisch op ons eigen werk en niet onder de indruk van hiërarchie. Een goed argument wint hier altijd van een functietitel.  Wat de stage inhoudt   Naast je afstudeeronderzoek werk je mee in de dagelijkse praktijk om de marktpositie van Twentyseven verder te versterken:  Marketing Workflows & Automation: Je bouwt en optimaliseert geautomatiseerde marketingprocessen (van contentcreatie tot posting en opvolging) met behulp van moderne AI-tools.  Contentcreatie & Thought Leadership: Je schrijft en redigeert scherpe B2B-content die onze expertise claimt.  Website & Conversion Optimization: Je analyseert (o.a. via Google Analytics) de performance van onze website en optimaliseert de content voor betere conversie.  Sales & Partner Marketing: Je helpt bij het verbinden van marketing met onze outbound salesactiviteiten en bouwt samenwerkingen met partners verder uit.  Bureaucoördinatie: Je werkt samen met en coördineert de opdrachten naar de interne zusterbureaus binnen Handpicked die ons ondersteunen op creatief en visueel vlak.  Events & Fundament: Je helpt mee bij het organiseren van relatie-events en legt richtlijnen vast voor onze Tone of Voice en marketingguidelines.  Dit is onze ideale Marketingstagiair:  Je volgt een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Marketing, Communicatie, Digital Business, Commerciële Economie of een gerelateerde studierichting;  Je hebt uitstekende copywriting- en redactievaardigheden in het Nederlands (en bij voorkeur Engels);  Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI-tools en weet hoe je deze praktisch kunt inzetten voor marketingefficiëntie;  Je hebt affiniteit met data en analyse (kennis van Google Analytics is een pré) om beslissingen te onderbouwen;  Je kunt 'uitzoomen': je kijkt niet alleen naar een losse post, maar begrijpt hoe marketing bijdraagt aan de strategische doelen van een B2B-organisatie;  Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en durft kritische vragen te stellen.  De realiteit De doelgroep. Je schrijft voor CMO’s en CTO’s van grote organisaties. Ze zijn sceptisch en druk, en hebben al te veel AI-keynotes gezien. Oppervlakkige content valt bij hen direct door de mand. De organisatie. Je werkt tussen directie, projectmanagement, sales en een extern creatief team. Je leert afstemmen, prioriteren en voet bij stuk houden. Het fundament. Wat jij neerzet, gebruiken wij na je stage nog steeds. Dat vraagt om keuzes die je kunt uitleggen en documentatie die anderen begrijpen. Wat wij bieden De praktische kant. Je krijgt €400 per maand. Je komt werken in de hub in Eindhoven, met mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Je bent voor 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar. Een afstudeeropdracht die blijft staan. Wat jij bouwt, gebruiken we na je stage nog. Je scriptie beschrijft dus iets wat echt draait, en geen casus die na je presentatie in een la verdwijnt. Begeleiding van dichtbij. O.a. onze algemeen directeur en onze senior projectmanager begeleiden je. De lijnen zijn kort, je krijgt regelmatig feedback en we zijn eerlijk, ook als dat even schuurt. Ruimte om te experimente

ACT. Now! Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. jobs.title: Team Lead Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Schreibe mit an der Erfolgsgeschichte von RAYMON und werde Teil unseres agilen Teams! Du glaubst, dass man das Rad jeden Tag neu erfinden kann? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Denn mit der R Raymon Bicycles GmbH gestalten wir schon heute die Mobilität von morgen. Wir entwickeln, designen und produzieren Fahrräder sowie E-Bikes für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Zur Verstärkung unseres internationales Teams, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Team Lead Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit. Aufgaben Team Leadership: Du übernimmst die operative Führung und Koordination unseres Marketing- & Event-Teams, entwickelst dein Team weiter und sorgst für klare Prioritäten, effiziente Abläufe und eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit. 360° Marketing: Du behältst sämtliche Marketingaktivitäten im Blick – von Website und B2B-Shop über Social Media, Newsletter und Retail Marketing bis hin zu PR, Events sowie der Betreuung unserer Athleten und Teams. Marketingplanung & Umsetzung: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Marketing entwickelst du unseren Marketingplan weiter, koordinierst Maßnahmen und stellst die konsequente und termingerechte Umsetzung sicher. Kampagnen & Kommunikation: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team und dem Head of Marketing kreative, zielgerichtete Kampagnen und begleitest diese von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg. Partner & Key Accounts: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere PR-Agentur und koordinierst Marketingaktivitäten mit Handelspartnern und Key Accounts – national wie international. Schnittstellenmanagement: Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Sales & Marketing und dem Head of Marketing zusammen, an den du direkt berichtest. Gleichzeitig bist du wichtiger Ansprechpartner für angrenzende Abteilungen wie Vertrieb und Produktmanagement. Events & Brand Experience: Ob internationale Messen, Händlerveranstaltungen oder eigene Events – du begleitest unsere Aktivitäten nicht nur aus dem Büro, sondern bist auch vor Ort dabei und packst selbst mit an. Qualifikation Marketing-Know-how: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketing mit, idealerweise in einer vielseitigen Position. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder BWL ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Leadership-Potenzial: Du kannst Menschen begeistern, Aufgaben koordinieren und Verantwortung übernehmen. Erste Führungserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit und dein Potenzial. Always up-to-date: Du hast ein Gespür für Trends, neue Technologien und innovative Marketingansätze. Du hinterfragst Bestehendes und bringst aktiv neue Ideen ein. Digital Mindset: Du bist offen für neue Technologien, digitale Tools und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen. Du erkennst Potenziale, um Marketingprozesse smarter, effizienter und zukunftsfähiger zu gestalten. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist dir für keine Aufgabe zu schade. Egal ob Kampagnenplanung, operative Unterstützung oder Eventaufbau – du packst dort an, wo du gebraucht wirst. 360°-Blick: Du denkst über einzelne Marketingkanäle hinaus, verstehst Zusammenhänge und hast auch angrenzende Unternehmensbereiche und wirtschaftliche Ziele im Blick. Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten. Bike Passion & Produktverständnis: Du interessierst dich für Fahrräder und unsere Branche. Du bist motiviert, dir ein tiefes Verständnis unserer Bikes, Technologien und Zielgruppen anzueignen und dieses Wissen gezielt in deine Arbeit einfließen zu lassen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl intern als auch mit internationalen Partnern. Flexibilität & Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gerne unterwegs und bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. 20–30% für Events, Messen und Partnertermine mit. Benefits Familiäres Team, starke Marke: Bei R Raymon Bicycles erwartet dich ein herzliches, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidung

jobs.title: SAP SD Inhouse Berater (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Für ein sehr renommiertes Unternehmen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen SAP SD Inhouse Berater (m/w/d). Aufgaben Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung des SAP-Moduls SD im S/4HANA-Umfeld Begleitung von SAP-Projekten von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme Beratung der Fachbereiche bei komplexen Fragestellungen im Order-to-Cash-Prozess Analyse, Optimierung und Dokumentation von Geschäftsprozessen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und unseren externen SAP-Partnern Durchführung von Customizing sowie Konzeption von effizienten und benutzerfreundlichen Lösungen Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen zu Prozessen, Schnittstellen und Erweiterungen Verantwortung für den 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support im Bereich SD Durchführung von Schulungen und Workshops für Key-User im Bereich Vertrieb und Distribution Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen (z. B. DSAG) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ca. fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im SAP SD Umfeld, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Preisfindung & Konditionstechnik, Terminierung, ATP-Prüfung. Gerne auch mit Erfahrung in der Advanced-ATP (aATP). Fundierte Kenntnisse im SAP SD Customizing sowie in der Integration mit angrenzenden Modulen (MM, LE, EWM, Fl). Kenntnisse in der Integration von Warehouse-Management-Systemen sind wünschenswert. Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP-Projekten, vorzugsweise im S/4HANA-Umfeld ABAP und Debugging-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind gewünscht. Analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Kommunikationsstärke und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamgeist Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (max. 5%) Benefits Spannende Projekte in einem innovativen S/4HANA SAP-Umfeld Die Sicherheit eines global agierenden Unternehmens mit nachhaltiger Wachstumsstrategie Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Urlaubstage Attraktive Angebote durch Zugang zu Corporate Benefits Flache Hierarchien und unbürokratische Strukturen Tätigkeitsbezogene, bedarfsorientierte fachliche Weiterbildung und Schulung Spannende Projekte mit viel Freiraum und Entwicklungschancen Wertschätzendes und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld, bei dem Chancengleichheit groß geschrieben wird Wenn Sie jemanden kennen, der zu dieser Position passen könnte, erhalten Sie die Chance von unserer Empfehlungsprovision i.H.v. 2000€ zu profitieren, sobald eine Vermittlung auf Basis Ihrer Empfehlung stattfindet. jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) für die 3D-Datenaufbereitung
jobs.description: aurivus ist ein innovatives Startup, das sich auf die Entwicklung einer hochmodernen KI zur 3D Datenverarbeitung in Web-Anwendungen spezialisiert hat. Inspiriert von den erfolgreichsten Softwareunternehmen der Welt haben wir eine starke Software- & KI-Entwicklung in Ulm aufgebaut. Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Werkstudenten (m/w/d) für die 3D-Datenaufbereitung. Aufgaben 3D-Daten-Labeling in Blender: Identifizieren und Markieren (Labeln) unterschiedlicher Elemente in 3D-Modellen. Nutzung eines eigens entwickelten Blender-Addons zur Vergabe der Labels. Dokumentation der gelabelten Daten und Prüfung auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit. Rückmeldung zu Funktionalität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit des Addons, ggf. Mitwirken bei der Optimierung des Workflows. 2D-Raumpläne nachzeichnen: Übertragung von digitalen oder Papier-Raumplänen in Blender als 2D-Layouts unter Verwendung einfacher Formen wie Linien oder extrudierten Polygonen. Überprüfung der Nachzeichnungen auf Genauigkeit und Konsistenz mit den Vorlagen. Eigenständiges Erkennen und Nachfragen bei fehlenden Informationen oder Unklarheiten in den Plänen. Allgemeine Unterstützung: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklungsteam und Kommunikation über den Status, Herausforderungen und mögliche Verbesserungen. Zusammenstellung und Pflege einfacher Dokumentationen zum Label-Prozess und den genutzten Methoden. Qualifikation Eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) IT-Affinität und Begeisterungsfähigkeit für neue Technologien Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Teamgeist und Kommunikationsstärke Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit der Arbeit mit Blender Unsere Aufgaben sind vielseitig. Begeistere uns mit deinen vielseitigen weiteren Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten. Benefits Das Beste an einem Startup ist, dass man mit guten Leuten zusammenarbeitet. Die Möglichkeit, an einem spannenden Produkt im KI-Bereich zu arbeiten, das sich stark auf 3D-Visualisierungen und Datenauswertungen fokussiert. Einen modernen und gesunden Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen, großen Bildschirmen und Sitz-Steh-Hockern Flexible Arbeitszeiteinteilung mit bis zu 20 Wochenstunden Die Tätigkeit erfolgt in Präsenz in unserem Büro im Science Park in Ulm Wir vergüten deine Leistung mit einem Stundenlohn von 15,00 € Wir bieten Startup-Feeling mit kurzen Kommunikationswegen Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung – ganz egal, welches Studienfach du belegst oder in welchem Semester du bist! Wenn du Lust hast, eigenständig zu arbeiten, kreativ zu denken und unser junges Team mitzugestalten, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the role 0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers. Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes: Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes Kubernetes clusters and managed databases A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs. What you'll own You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill. Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses. Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity. Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades. Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap. Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps. Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems. Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet. Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning. Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform. Our stack Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud Must-haves We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines. Kubernetes, in depth Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions. Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure. Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work. Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster. Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity

jobs.title: UI/UX Engineer
jobs.description: Betriebliche Steuern sind kompliziert – Steuerberatung muss es nicht sein. Für die meisten Unternehmen bedeutet sie bis heute Papierstapel, lange E-Mail-Verläufe und Warten. Das wollen wir grundlegend ändern. Bei b'steuern verbinden wir Steuerberatung, Software und KI von Anfang an miteinander. Unser Ziel ist nicht, eine klassische Steuerkanzlei einfach digitaler zu machen. Wir definieren neu, was Steuerberatung bdeutet: mit KI-Agenten, die ganze Arbeitsabläufe eigenständig übernehmen, und Software, die Menschen genau dort einbindet, wo sie gebraucht werden. Daraus entstehen Designfragen, für die es noch kaum etablierte Antworten gibt: Wie übergibt man Arbeit an einen KI-Agenten? Wie behält man den Überblick, wenn mehrere Agenten gleichzeitig arbeiten? Wann kann man ihren Ergebnissen vertrauen? Und wie gestaltet man die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Menschen und KI so, dass sie sich einfach und selbstverständlich anfühlt? Als UI/UX Engineer findest du Antworten auf diese Fragen – und setzt sie selbst in funktionierende Software um. Du gestaltest die Produkte, mit denen unsere Mandant:innen und unser Steuerteam täglich arbeiten. Und weil viele dieser Produkte und Prozesse noch gar nicht existieren, entscheidest du von Anfang an mit, wie sie aussehen sollen. Deine Aufgaben Die Arbeit unseres Steuerteams neu denken. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere internen Werkzeuge täglich nutzen. Gemeinsam findet ihr heraus, wo Software und KI ihre Arbeit einfacher, schneller und besser machen können – und wie die passenden Werkzeuge dafür aussehen. Die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Menschen und KI gestalten. Unsere Agenten übernehmen zunehmend ganze Arbeitsabläufe. Du entwickelst die Interaktionen und Oberflächen, mit denen Menschen Aufgaben delegieren, Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, Entscheidungen treffen und bei Bedarf eingreifen können. Die Mandant:innen-Erfahrung weiterentwickeln. Du gestaltest, wie Mandant ihre Steuerangelegenheiten erleben: einfach, transparent und ohne unnötigen Aufwand. Sie sollen jederzeit wissen, was gerade passiert und was als Nächstes ansteht. Selbst gestalten und umsetzen. Du gehst von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur fertigen Anwendung. Du entwickelst deine Lösungen selbst und bringst sie in den Livebetrieb. Unser Designsystem aufbauen und weiterentwickeln. Du schaffst die Grundlagen, mit denen wir auch bei schnellem Wachstum konsistente, intuitive und hochwertige Oberflächen entwickeln können. Das bringst du mit Du kannst gestalten und bauen. Du hast Erfahrung darin, digitale Produkte zu konzipieren und selbst umzusetzen. Du denkst nicht in getrennten Design- und Entwicklungsphasen, sondern willst, dass aus guten Ideen funktionierende Software wird. Du verstehst Softwareentwicklung. Du hast bereits anspruchsvolle Softwareprojekte entwickelt und verstehst die technischen Zusammenhänge dahinter: von Anwendungslogik und Datenflüssen bis zu Schnittstellen und Architekturentscheidungen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für UX. Du erkennst, wo Nutzer den Überblick verlieren, Informationen fehlen oder Interaktionen unnötig kompliziert werden. Klare Nutzerführung und durchdachte Details sind dir wichtig. Du denkst AI-native. Du hinterfragst ständig, wie du mit KI besser und schneller arbeiten kannst, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und teilst erfolgreiche Workflows mit dem Team. Du übernimmst Verantwortung. Du brauchst keine fertig priorisierte Aufgabenliste. Du findest selbst heraus, was wichtig ist, triffst Entscheidungen auch bei unklaren Anforderungen und kannst sie begründen. Du diskutierst offen und konstruktiv. Du vertrittst deine Meinung, gibst klares Feedback und lässt dich vom besseren Argument überzeugen. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und fließend Englisch und lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, hierherzuziehen. Erfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Start-up, mit KI-Produkten und komplexen internen Werkzeugen ist ein Plus. Ein bestimmter Abschluss, ein klassischer Werdegang oder viele Jahre Berufserfahr

This is a hybrid role.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies.
