jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.</h2> <p>We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.</p> <p>We are now looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer (Golang)</strong> to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.</p> <p>This role will be based in <strong>London</strong>, <strong>UK</strong> as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.</p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.</li> <li>Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.</li> <li>Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.</li> <li>Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.</li> <li>Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.</li> <li>Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY. The Role We’re looking for an AI Ops Engineer to build the internal systems that help Kernel scale without adding unnecessary manual work. You’ll work across GTM, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations - finding the highest-leverage problems and building practical AI-powered workflows. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll take ideas from a vague business problem to a tool or workflow that people use, then maintain and improve it in production. You’ll choose the fastest sensible approach for each problem - coding agents, automation platforms, APIs, data pipelines or lightweight code. You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership. You’ll sit with our BDRs, AEs and Account Managers and learn how they work day to day. Then you’ll automate everything that doesn’t need a human. jobs.title: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge
jobs.description: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week Team: Product Start date: ASAP About Neural Concept Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time. About the role Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line. We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself. As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives. You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production. What you will do Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page. Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use. Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on. Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements. Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results. Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release. Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail. Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform. Who you are Must have Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation. Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools. Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction. Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git. A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps. Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams. Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate. Nice to have Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost pr

À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables. GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets. Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires. Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source. jobs.title: AI Engineer

Dit combineer je met minimaal HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau. Technisch Leider: Je bent besluitvaardig op het gebied en durft op technisch gebied verantwoordelijkheid te dragen. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
jobs.description: We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person. “The entire customer journey. One platform” What we value Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values : Drive and Lead You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward. Grow and Learn The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others. Together and Care We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. Speed and Change By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment. The Role As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it. In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback. Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs. You will Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL Fluent in English and Dutch Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together. What we offer As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits: Onboarding : Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com. Healthy food:  Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized. Effortless commute:  The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well. Invest in your future : A solid pension plan. Time off:  Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days. Own your success:  Become a shareholder

jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Dein Profil Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze) PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1 Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter. At RobCo, we don’t just build robots, we are redefining the relationship between hardware and AI. Our end-to-end solutions seamlessly combine advanced, scalable industrial hardware with a central software suite powered by Physical AI to make manufacturing truly autonomous, efficient, and scalable. By delivering field-ready robotic solutions that just work, we empower industrial companies to automate without complexity and successfully solve the global labor shortage. At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Control & Low-Level Software (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of automation solutions. In this key role, you will lead the team behind how our robots move: RobControl, the real-time controller running on every RobCo robot, together with control unit software, robot modeling and hardware integration. One controller codebase drives our modular robots, OEM configurations and Alfie, our autonomous industrial robot, so your team's work reaches every robot in the field. Managing a team of control, embedded and software engineers, you will balance new capabilities for Alfie and our physical AI roadmap with the reliability factory customers expect on every shift. Improve observability so field issues can be diagnosed remotely and quickly. Manage technical debt and architectural health as we scale. Partner Across Teams: Work with Product Management, Hardware, Safety & Compliance and Robot Intelligence to turn customer and autonomy needs into a clear roadmap, integrate RobControl with the safety controller, and support certification against ISO 10218 and ISO 13849. Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles. We're looking for someone who has: Completed a university degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that ship real-time or embedded software for robots, motion systems or other industrial machines. Strong C++ and Python on real-time Linux, with hands-on EtherCAT and ROS 2 experience. Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency. Expert knowledge of modern SDLC practices for software that runs on hardware, including hardware-in-the-loop testing and staged releases, with a track record of improving release frequency and field stability. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend. The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. The Role We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen. This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off. We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you. Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete. The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how. What you'll be doing Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality. Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition. Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book. Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk

Send the reports out every week, to everyone. Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team. Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster. Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed. Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written. Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description: <p>The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model's outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design and build custom mid-size models for high-throughput stream processing, and train them at scale.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Optimize these models from start to finish, working across both the mathematics and the systems, often by finding mathematical reformulations that fit the hardware and software constraints better.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build the training data pipelines the work depends on when they do not already exist, from the raw stream to a training-ready dataset.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Work with engineering to integrate models into production, with a clear focus on GPU utilization, latency, and cost per record on live traffic.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Plan the roadmap of model and system improvements, based on a solid understanding of the product and of what matters most to users.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build an agentic layer on top of the models to analyze, validate, and act on their outputs.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build lightweight interpretability tools that make model behavior easier to explain to the people who rely on it.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Maintain and monitor the models, services, and infrastructure your team owns, and take part in your team's on

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description: <p>AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.</p> <p>Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.</p> <p>The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.</li> <li>Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.</li> <li>Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.</li> <li>Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.</li> <li>Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and exper

Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
jobs.description: L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur. Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire. Vos responsabilités principales : Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH. Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux. Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH. Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif. Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs. Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur. Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire. Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales . Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH. Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers. Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH. Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraid

jobs.title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
jobs.description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Doc

jobs.title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit Zuid NL
jobs.description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén. Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt. Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol. Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander. jobs.title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
jobs.description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months. Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once. Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines. At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets. Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance. Nice to have, not essential Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite. Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail. A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply. Benefits A monthly internship allowance Hybrid, with agreed office days Lunch with the team A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. Knowing what a good afternoon feels like is part of the job Sounds like your kind of work? Please apply with your CV and a cover letter, both in English. jobs.title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.description: The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets. Engineering Deliverables Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership. Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience. Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams. Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends. Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate Scope The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership. Required Skills Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience. Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights. Independent problem solving: Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources. Hiring Ranges: Remote Germany $62,100—$82,800 USD

jobs.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Women's Health and Organ Health)
jobs.description: Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team of Bioinformatics Scientists in our Women's Health and Organ Health research organization. You will oversee the scientific planning and execution of research and assay-development of diagnostic projects, and you will be responsible for creating production-ready pipeline components. You will manage your team and its professional growth, the research strategy behind new product development, and the handoff of research work into production. The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors. Primary Responsibilities: Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to. Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order. Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment. Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it. Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling. Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and containerization. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science. Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and many strong candidates come from environments where they were restricted; we provide the tooling and the ramp time. Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company. What success looks like after a year: The team has a research roadmap you own, and progress against it is visible outside the team. You independently advise and guide research strategies in cross functional settings. New analysis methods from your team are implemented within production code and demonstrate expected performance on benchmark studies.. You and team members become trusted experts that other functions direct their hard questions to, and can independently support decision making. AI agent-assisted work is normal on the team, with a standard for it that you set. Qualifications: Ph.D. in Bioinform

jobs.title: AWS Data Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. This is a senior role in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters, at meaningfully lower engagement cost than traditional data consulting. Customers come to us after a data program has stalled pipelines nobody trusts, warehouses nobody runs new workloads on, a modernization that produced diagrams instead of production systems. Aedeon handles automated source discovery, schema mapping, lineage extraction, and parallel-run validation. You own what agents can't: target architecture, data model decisions, pipeline design under real constraints, and the calls that make a cutover safe. You'll build with PySpark and SQL on EMR and Glue, model for Redshift, Snowflake, Athena, and Presto, orchestrate with Airflow and your work will reach production, not a slide deck. What you will do? Build and maintain data pipelines on Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue that run in production. Design data models and end-user querying on Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. Build and maintain pipeline orchestration with Airflow. Work with customer and internal teams to understand data needs and design the solutions that meet them. Troubleshoot and optimize pipelines and data models until they hold up under real load. Write and maintain PySpark and SQL scripts to extract, transform, and load data. Document and communicate technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences — customers sign off on what we ship. Track new AWS data technologies and judge their impact on the systems we run. What are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience working with PySpark and SQL. 2+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue. 2+ years of experience with data modeling and end-user querying using Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. 1+ years of experience building and maintaining pipeline orchestration using Airflow. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. You are preferred if you have AWS Data Analytics Specialty Certification Experience with Agile development methodology How we work? We run a forward-deployed model. Senior engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally fixed dates, with Mactores absorbing overage cost for delays inside our control. Aedeon absorbs scale; you absorb judgment. That means less of your week goes to inventory spreadsheets and manual validation, and more goes to architecture, data modeling, and cutover strategy. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We measure ourselves by what ships. Compensation Additional Information Life at Mactores We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work. 1. Be one step ahead 2. Deliver the best 3. Be bold 4. Pay attention to the detail 5. Enjoy the challenge 6. Be curious and take action 7. Take leadership 8. Own it 9. Deliver value 10. Be collaborative

jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance. Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process. Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content. Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field . Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones . Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills. Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time. Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts. Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. jobs.description: About CircleCI Engineering CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. At CircleCI , our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil. Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on. We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization. What You'll Do Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on. Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate. Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done. Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns. Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage. Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows. What You'll Bring Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work. Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed. Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along. Key Responsibilities: Review incoming files against tickets, checking trim size, bleed, margins, image resolution, fonts, colour specifications, page count, page order, overprint, trapping, rich black, and missing assets. Use Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro, and Enfocus PitStop to resolve prepress issues. Coordinate with account managers when corrections require input. Manage PDF proofs, generate and send proofs for approval, implement requested changes, and issue revised proofs until approval is received. Prepare press-ready layouts based on press specifications and paper sizes, including step-and-repeat, work-and-turn, sheetwise, booklet signatures, creep adjustments, registration marks, and colour bars. Create new layouts when an existing template does not accommodate dimensions or specifications. Process approved files through Kodak Prinergy and, where required, Fujifilm XMF, ensuring files are ready for the in-house team. Manage production priorities in coordination with account managers, balancing deadlines, approvals, and production requirements. Communicate proactively, keep account managers informed of file issues, pending approvals, and potential delays, using email, chat, and phone as needed. What You'll Need to Succeed: At least 3 years of hands-on prepress experience with a commercial offset printing company, either sheetfed or web. Proven experience imposing print, and preparing files for production. Daily, practical experience with professional prepress workflows and imposition software. Kodak Prinergy and Preps are preferred; experience with Fujifilm XMF, Screen Trueflow, Heidelberg Prinect, or Agfa Apogee is also relevant. Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac. Experience with Enfocus PitStop for preflight, PDF inspection, and file correction. A solid understanding of commercial print production, including colour separations, CMYK and spot colours, Pantone specifications, overprint, trapping, bleeds, and print marks. Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally Strong attention to detail, sound production judgment, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently. Reliable internet with speeds of at least 25 Mbps, a backup internet connection, backup power, and a quiet, suitable workspace. Location: Remote Originally posted on Himalayas
